entries.name: JavaNativeFoundation
entries.note: The bridge from a desktop Java toolkit to the native windowing layer; BifrOSt ships no such toolkit.

entries.name: JavaRuntimeSupport
entries.note: The jdk-openjdk Arch package provides the Java runtime that Java programs run on. Gap: the Cocoa Java bridge and its bridge-support metadata are not provided.
entries.ready_note: jdk-openjdk provides the Java runtime. The Cocoa Java bridge is not covered.

entries.name: JavaVM
entries.note: jdk-openjdk provides the OpenJDK virtual machine as an ordinary process. Gap: there is no embedding API that lets an app start a Java VM in process.
entries.ready_note: OpenJDK from jdk-openjdk runs Java programs as an ordinary process. The in-process embedding API is not covered.

entries.name: Kerberos
entries.note: Audit 2026-10-13: pure kit model with host tests; not wired, not tested on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: kinit and klist through the SDK (sdk/src/krb5_client.rs, tests krb5_client::tests), using the credential cache from gss_krb5. Not covered: the GSS context export and ticket cache copy.
entries.ready_note: kinit and klist are run through the SDK and their output is parsed (krb5_client::tests). The GSS context export and cache copy are not covered.

entries.name: Kernel
entries.note: from SDK matrix kernel.json

entries.name: KernelManagement
entries.note: Kernel extension management is an Apple kernel service. Linux loads drivers through the kernel and udev, and BifrOSt exposes no SDK framework for them.

entries.name: LDAP
entries.note: Audit 2026-10-13: pure kit model with host tests; not wired, not tested on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: directory nodes filled from ldapsearch (sdk/src/ldap_directory.rs, tests ldap_directory::tests). Simple anonymous binds only; base64 LDIF attributes are skipped.
entries.ready_note: ldapsearch LDIF is parsed into directory records and loaded into a directory node (ldap_directory::tests). Authenticated binds and base64 attributes are not covered.

entries.name: LatentSemanticMapping

entries.name: LightweightCodeRequirements
entries.note: from SDK matrix lightweightcoderequirements.json

entries.name: LinkPresentation
entries.note: from SDK matrix link-presentation.json Built 2026-10-17: Metadata parsing, relative address resolution and fetch state (timeout, cancel, typed LinkError) in springboard/sdk/src/link_metadata.rs (tests link_metadata::tests); the request and the rich link view are still open.

entries.name: LinkSecurity
entries.note: Link reputation checks for messages and mail are a reference-platform service; BifrOSt has no link checking service.

entries.name: LiveCommunicationKit
entries.note: The live call user interface is tied to Apple telephony, and BifrOSt has no telephony stack.

entries.name: LocalAuthentication
entries.note: from SDK matrix local-authentication.json Built 2026-10-17: the policy check is decided by the biometry model and device_state reports biometry none (SDK LAContext.biometry_type). Open: the authentication sheet is not drawn and biometry stays absent.

entries.note: from SDK matrix local-authentication-embedded-ui.json

entries.name: JavaLaunching
entries.note: The java launcher from jdk-openjdk starts Java programs. Gap: launching a Java application bundle from the desktop is not provided.

entries.name: JavaScriptAppleEvents
entries.note: Bridges JavaScript to the event channel used to script other apps. Build a JavaScript automation bridge that calls the app control sockets (bifrost pc control) so scripts can drive apps.

entries.name: JavaScriptOSA
entries.note: Runs JavaScript automation scripts through the scripting component layer. Build a JavaScript script runner on the app control sockets, shared with the JavaScript event bridge row.

entries.name: Jet
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified. The extract has only its bundle property lists, and the binary is in the shared cache, which the extract does not expose. Left as os.

entries.name: JetAsset
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified. The extract has only its bundle property lists, and the binary is in the shared cache, which the extract does not expose. Left as os.

entries.name: JetCore
entries.note: The index shows the jetpackassetd daemon, which downloads Apple-hosted asset packs for Apple's own services. BifrOSt has no counterpart service and no content store to serve.

entries.name: JetEngine
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified. The extract has only its bundle property lists, and the binary is in the shared cache, which the extract does not expose. Left as os.

entries.name: JetFoundation
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified. The extract has only its bundle property lists, and the binary is in the shared cache, which the extract does not expose. Left as os.

entries.name: JetUI
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified. The extract has only its bundle property lists, and the binary is in the shared cache, which the extract does not expose. Left as os.

entries.name: JoinRequests
entries.note: Private framework for join requests. The owning feature is not identified: the bundle has only property lists (copyright 2022), and the binary is in the shared cache. Left as os.

entries.name: JournalShared
entries.note: Shared data model (moments.momd, versions 22 to 27) of the reference Journal app. BifrOSt ships no journal app, so nothing here has a caller.

entries.name: KRExperiments
entries.note: Trial experiment factors (namespace descriptors and factor files) that the reference vendor delivers remotely to its own OS. BifrOSt runs no remote experiment service.

entries.name: KerberosHelper
entries.note: Helper (lkdc_acl) for the local Kerberos realm the reference system runs for its own accounts. BifrOSt runs no such realm; the krb5 package listed in tools/parity/os_cli_packages.txt covers Kerberos clients if they are needed.

entries.name: KeyboardLayouts
entries.note: The layout table is generated from xkeyboard-config through libxkbcommon, with console keymaps for the installer. Gap: the layouts are not verified on the lab machine.

entries.name: KeyboardServices
entries.note: Text replacements and learned words are served by the shell text service, and spelling runs on the core spellcheck model. Gap: there is no user dictionary store that syncs across devices, and the reference text replacement models are not read.
entries.ready_note: Text replacements and learned words are served by the shell text service (bifrost-app text_services::tests), and spelling runs on the core spellcheck model (bifrost-core spellcheck::tests). No cross-device dictionary sync.

entries.name: KeychainCircle
entries.note: The keychain peer circle that syncs saved secrets between the reference vendor's devices through its cloud. BifrOSt's keychain is local (springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs), and it has no peer circle.

entries.name: KnowledgeGraphKit
entries.note: Knowledge graph library with no caller identified in the extract (bundle property list only). Left as os.

entries.name: KnowledgeMonitor
entries.note: Monitor for the reference on-device usage knowledge store (identifier com.apple.coreduet.KnowledgeMonitor). BifrOSt runs no usage-prediction store.

entries.name: Koa
entries.note: Component of the reference assistant (identifier com.apple.siri.koa). BifrOSt has no reference assistant backend to serve.

entries.name: KoaMapper
entries.note: Mapping component of the reference assistant with a CarPlay schema (identifier com.apple.siri.KoaMapper). It serves the reference assistant and in-car stack, which BifrOSt does not run.

entries.name: LLMCache
entries.note: Cache of the reference assistant's language model (identifier com.apple.siri.LLMCache). BifrOSt has no reference language model store.

entries.name: LanguageModeling
entries.note: Language modeling framework (2013 copyright) with no caller identified in the extract. Left as os until its owner is found.

entries.name: LearnedFeatures
entries.note: Learned 3D vision feature models (espresso weights and model.mil files under Resources/Models and CV3D_LearnedFeatures_* bundles, seen in the reference index). These are Apple ML model packs with no BifrOSt runtime or caller, so n/a.

entries.name: LegalAndRegulatorySettingsSupport
entries.note: Regulatory and legal notice text for the reference vendor's hardware, shown in its settings (localized strings only in the extract). BifrOSt has no such hardware notices.

entries.name: Leo
entries.note: Private framework with no owner identified (bundle property list only). Left as os.

entries.name: Leonardo
entries.note: 3D render graphs, USD scenes and a Metal library for tracker and detector scenes. No owning app is identified, so it stays os.

entries.name: Lexicon
entries.note: Dictionary lookup reads StarDict packages, and spelling uses a word list in the core spellcheck model. Gap: the reference collation, confusables and word usage data are not provided.
entries.ready_note: Dictionary lookup reads StarDict packages (bifrost-ui stardict) and spelling uses the core spellcheck word list; both are tested. Collation and confusables data are not covered.

entries.name: LibraryRepair
entries.note: Reference system daemon com.apple.library-repair.agent (an XPC agent repairing the reference library caches). Arch verifies installed files with pacman, but BifrOSt names no repair service in its runtime packages, so it stays os until that decision is made.

entries.name: LinkMetadata
entries.note: Link metadata is read from a page head into a card with placeholder, loading, timeout and completion states, tested headless. Gap: no network fetch, image or icon download, redirect following or share-sheet preview; the caller does those.
entries.ready_note: Link card model covered by bifrost-ui linkmeta::tests: placeholder, loading, timeout and completion states. The network fetch and image download stay with the caller.

entries.name: LocalFederatedSearch
entries.note: Entities an app lists are indexed into the shared Core Search index, so a search finds them without launching the app. Gap: there is no cross-app federated search service, and per-app indexes are not merged into one result set.
entries.ready_note: Entities that apps list are indexed into the shared search index (bifrost-app indexed_entity), tested. Cross-app federated merging is not covered.

entries.name: LocationAccessStore
entries.note: Per-app location grants and the authorization status and error model are in the privacy and location services, with the status model in springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs. Gap: there is no separate authorization daemon, and the grant prompt is not verified on the lab machine.
entries.ready_note: Per-app location grants live in shell::services::privacy_permissions and shell::services::location; the authorization status and error model is bifrost-ui location_auth. All three have unit tests. The separate authorization daemon is not part of these checks.

entries.name: LocationAuthorizationFramework
entries.note: Per-app location grants and the authorization status and error model are in the privacy and location services, with the status model in springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs. Gap: there is no separate authorization daemon, and the grant prompt is not verified on the lab machine.
entries.ready_note: The authorization status and error model (bifrost-ui location_auth) and the per-app grant store are tested. No separate daemon is part of these checks.

entries.name: LocationAuthorizationXPC
entries.note: Per-app location grants and the authorization status and error model are in the privacy and location services, with the status model in springboard/ui/src/location_auth.rs. Gap: there is no separate authorization daemon, and the grant prompt is not verified on the lab machine.
entries.ready_note: Authorization status and error model covered by bifrost-ui location_auth::tests; per-app grants are in the privacy and location services. There is no separate authorization daemon.

entries.name: LocationLogEncryption
entries.note: Encryption of the reference location log store. BifrOSt writes no location log, so there is no store to encrypt; the row does not apply.

entries.name: LocationSupport
entries.note: Reference bundle com.apple.LocationSupport with only an Info.plist in the reference extract (no binary, strings or headers were readable), so the purpose is not determined and it stays os.

entries.name: LockdownMode
entries.note: Apple's lockdownmoded hardening profile for Apple's own platform services. It relies on Apple signed-code and firmware controls that BifrOSt does not have, so there is no equivalent profile to build.

entries.name: LockdownModeUI
entries.note: Settings and prompt UI for Apple's Lockdown Mode profile. It depends on the Lockdown Mode service above, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: LockoutUI
entries.note: Partial: the Time Limit lockout cover (Limit and Downtime, Ignore Limit for 1 more minute, 15 minutes or today, behind the Screen Time passcode) is built in springboard/src/shell/screentime/shield.rs. Gap: the sign-in attempt lock panel (springboard/core/src/password_verify.rs keeps the counter, but no lock screen panel shows the lockout and wait time yet). Not verified on Midget.
entries.ready_note: The Time Limit lockout cover (Limit, Downtime, ignore for a minute, passcode gate) is in shell::screentime::shield, with tests. The sign-in attempt lock is not covered.

entries.name: LoggingSupport
entries.note: Unified logging for apps (os.Logger and the log store) is implemented in bifrost_core::log, with per-argument privacy formatting in springboard/core/src/log_format.rs. Gap: system-wide journal integration with systemd is not verified on the lab machine.
entries.ready_note: Unified logging for apps (the Logger API and the log store) is in bifrost_core::log, with per-argument privacy formatting in log_format.rs; both have unit tests. Journal integration with systemd is not part of this check.

entries.name: LoginUIKit
entries.note: Reference bundle com.apple.LoginUIKit with only an Info.plist in the reference extract (no binary, strings or headers were readable), so the purpose is not determined and it stays os.
entries.ready_note: Login window UI: the shell login window (shell::login) draws the avatar, password field and power controls it needs; the reference login UI assets are not shipped as-is.

entries.name: Lookup
entries.note: Partial: the Look Up popover (Services menu Look Up and Ctrl+Cmd+D) shows the dictionary definition and quick search hits for the selected word, with Search and Open in Dictionary actions. Not built: a system Look Up service that other apps can call; the popover belongs to the shell and the dictionary app looks words up only inside itself.
entries.ready_note: Dictionary definition and quick search hits for a selected word, shown in the Look Up popover; the lookup model (bifrost-ui look_up) and the popover (shell::look_up_popover) have tests. A system Look Up service is not part of these checks.

entries.name: LowPowerMode
entries.note: The shell hands its power profile to power-profiles-daemon through powerprofilesctl. Gap: there is no Low Power Mode toggle or app-facing power-state API, and the profile change is not verified on the lab machine. Built 2026-10-17 (verified existing): Low Power Mode switch on the Battery page (src/shell/pages.rs), SDK ProcessInfo::is_low_power_mode_enabled and observe_low_power_mode, and the desktop power-saver hand-off to power-profiles-daemon (boost::tests).
entries.ready_note: The Battery page switch, the SDK low power query and change event, and the power-saver hand-off are covered by these tests. No Control Center tile yet: the cluster grid has no free slot.

entries.name: kperf
entries.note: Apple's kernel-private performance counter bridge. Its counter-reading job is taken by Linux perf_event_open, tracked on the kperfdata row.

entries.name: kperfdata
entries.note: The reference counter library reads hardware performance counters. Linux perf reads the same counters through perf_event_open and its command-line tools are in the package list. BifrOSt has no SDK counter API, and the perf probe is not verified on Midget.

entries.name: ktrace
entries.note: Kernel trace session library for the reference's trace tooling. Syscall tracing is covered by strace in the runtime package list, but no kernel event trace API is mirrored, and no daily-desktop job needs one, so it stays os.

entries.name: libmalloc_exclaves_introspector
entries.note: Introspects allocations inside the reference vendor's exclave secure-world environment, which runs on that vendor's hardware. Linux has no such environment and BifrOSt has no counterpart.

entries.name: libsat
entries.note: Self-test library for the reference vendor's Thunderbolt controller (bundle com.apple.internal.AppleThunderboltSAT.libsat). BifrOSt uses the Linux Thunderbolt driver and has no vendor controller test.

entries.name: lighthouse_runtime
entries.note: Only the bundle identifier (com.apple.lighthouse-runtime) was readable from the reference image. Its job is not determined, so it stays os.

entries.name: login
entries.note: The lock screen draws the login window, the account avatar, the password field and the power menu. The reference's login user service (LoginUserService XPC) and its multi-user login logic are not built.
entries.ready_note: The lock screen login window (avatar, password field, power menu) is in shell::login, with tests. Multi-user login logic is not covered.
